part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `coerceToVNode` (src/diff/children.js:54): bigint children fell through to the "return as-is" branch since `typeof 5n === 'bigint'` matches neither `'string'` nor `'number'`, so preact later tried to assign internal vnode properties (`_parent`, etc. — the `__` property in the minified build) directly onto the primitive, throwing the TypeError.

Changes:
- `src/diff/children.js` — accept `typeof childVNode == 'bigint'` in `coerceToVNode` so bigints become text vnodes and render as their string form (e.g. `5n` → `5`).
- `src/internal.d.ts` / `src/index.d.ts` — add `bigint` to the `ComponentChild` union.

Verification (in the eval container):
- `test:karma`: the 2 `should render bigint as text content` failures now pass; failure set is otherwise identical to baseline (97 pre-existing, unrelated failures).
- `test:mocha`: 29 passing; `tsc -p test/ts/` and `tsc -p compat/test/ts/` clean.
